findings.description: The radar block can now draw more rows than App reserves for it (append notes are never budgeted), so the frame can reach terminal height.

`pup status` prints the append-only note without the `(stale)` suffix every OVERLAP row gets. The `radar off` line only shows when 2 or more sessions are live, so after the watcher dies and sessions finish, a dead scan's README-only pairs show as a fresh 'docs/adr/README.md: 6 sessions append' line; before this PR they showed as OVERLAP rows marked `(stale)`. Append `snapshot.radarStale ? '  (stale)' : ''` to the note.

The `radarView` JSDoc says "(decision 109, amending 104)", but 0153 is the decision that amends 104; 109 is the index decision. A reader who follows 109 won't find this rule. Change it to "decision 153, amending 104".

The `APPEND_ONLY_DIR` and `filesWorthANotice` JSDoc still say the filter applies to "a peer-joined introduction" only. It now also feeds `radarView` and `overlapCount` in `review.service.ts`. The next reader of `review.service.ts` will think the filter is introduction-specific. Add a clause naming those callers.

The comment above `describe('append-only files')` is garbled: "so the pair is a line per pair of sessions and hides the real overlap" reads as if the pair is the line; say the index makes one OVERLAP line per pair of sessions, hiding the real file behind `(+1 more)`.

process_issues.description: review-conventions reported `gh pr diff 277` failed with a sandbox `.git/config.worktree.lock` error; it fell back to `git diff <merge_base>..HEAD` and file reads, so coverage was not lost.
